changes: Schema 10 persists prepare/apply intent IDs and exact reviewed proposal content before network mutation.
Public bind prepare/apply validates identity, physical workspace and launch consent, explicit proof and proposal hash.
Lost responses reuse the same durable intent; changed content and changed authority are refused.
Binding acknowledgment and the local realization status commit atomically; failure leaves one recoverable application.
Public bind show/list reads canonical intent and acknowledged binding state, including installed subprocess verification.
Nexus maps binding domain refusals to structured revision-bearing HTTP errors.

failure_history.finding: Canonical JSON refused dataclass tuple values. Hashing now normalizes the same JSON shape persisted by StateStore.
Uncaught permission refusal produced HTTP 500 and a protocol mismatch. Binding routes now return structured domain errors.

limitations: Actual loopback HTTP, authenticated daemon IPC and operator approval are exercised with seeded identity, a technical vault and harmless copied discovery executable.
No provider starts and no runtime or outbox operation is created by binding onboarding. Real remote Pi/Codex/Claude acceptance remains pending.
Canonical runtime CLI admission and reusable alias mapping are next; full binding replacement/removal remains pending under M03/M10.
Source and installed suites overlap and must not be summed as unique coverage.
Preexisting Nexus UI assets are present in the wheel but excluded from these commits and UI acceptance.
Core is unchanged; earlier real local provider evidence remains tied to Core 0.2.42.
M00-M13 and G0-G3 completion criteria are unchanged; no milestone or gate is closed.
